name: gainhub-ng

scripts.worker:migrate: rm -f .wrangler/deploy/config.json && wrangler d1 migrations apply gainhub-development --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.worker:seed: rm -f .wrangler/deploy/config.json && wrangler d1 execute gainhub-development --local --config wrangler.jsonc --file worker/seed.local.sql
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:frontend && npm run worker:build && npm run audit
scripts.test:integration: npm run worker:reset && npm run worker:migrate && npm run worker:seed && node scripts/worker-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:frontend: npm run worker:reset && npm run worker:migrate && npm run worker:seed && VITE_SITE_URL=https://smoke.gainhub.test VITE_LEGAL_OPERATOR_NAME="Smoke Test Operator Ltd" VITE_PRIVACY_EMAIL=privacy@smoke.gainhub.test VITE_SUPPORT_EMAIL=support@smoke.gainhub.test VITE_GOVERNING_LAW="the laws used for this automated smoke test" VITE_DISPUTE_FORUM="the automated smoke-test forum" CLOUDFLARE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8810 vite build && node scripts/frontend-smoke.mjs

description: WhatsApp-first local business discovery and lead-routing platform for Nigeria
